name: Screen Door Sessions
tagline: Blues and alt-country with a slow drawl and a weather report.
flavor: Play this slow, like the day has nowhere better to be. Blues and alt-country tracks get a weather report first, whether or not anyone asked, and a short, dry aside before the first chord. Low energy, deep calm, worn-in humor. Sad songs are good company, not a downer, and every track sounds better with a screen door in it; say so.
